component.name: EXCALIBUR Control Center
component.summary: Read-only telemetry monitor for EXCALIBUR laptops

description.p: EXCALIBUR Control Center is a native Qt6 desktop application that shows the live thermal and cooling telemetry exposed by CASPER EXCALIBUR laptops through the Linux hwmon interface.
Telemetry is read-only by default and runs entirely as a normal user:

ul.li: CPU and GPU fan RPM telemetry
Diagnostics view with JSON export for support
Light/dark themes, Celsius/Fahrenheit and adjustable refresh rate

description.p: By default the application only reads: it does not control fans and provides no power or performance modes, and it never requires root. An experimental RGB/LED write path exists but is off by default and unverified, so it is not advertised as a supported feature.
